notes.title: LOTS OF STUFF + STUDIO UPDATE!!!
notes.content:
SilviuShader here! 
Less than 3 months passed since the last update. Now I don't know about you, but for me it seems like fast progress! Like c'mon!

[h1]Progress[/h1]

To be honest, quite a lot was added/ improved since the previous update. Here are some of the things (and I hope I didn't miss many of them):

[h2]New spaceship car model + thrusters[/h2]

Look at this beauty: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/49f39d45619d4c27530b2ac2e5eb54851931e57c.jpg[/img]

Sexy, isn't it? Will work a bit more on the colors, and the emissive lights of this car, but tbh it's pretty much production-ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/d418631cb16821d3c0b82440f44afe6e9fdcd987.png[/img]

[h2]Focus mode[/h2]

You know that Subway Surfers video that plays during TikTok videos that helps you focus on the content? What if instead a video, it was actually a game you could play on the PC while doing work? 

Well, I implemented just that. Another game mode that creates a small always-on-top window on the right side of the screen where you can play the game (or not) while doing important work on the left side of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/51e1015f4b06a3e70c2bb63b1946d74977e5363e.png[/img]

[h2]Collisions with the environment[/h2]

Ok, so these were implemented for a very long time, however they didn't impact gameplay at all since the player couldn't go that far. 

Now when the player touches the environment or the sides of the screen the spaceship does a cool little bounce.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/ce490671e569b3fb50a61d824285a95b7dc6200f.gif[/img]

[h2]Quality of life[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/3b176eeb565822566d8418234500c9b10d636637.jpg[/img]

Added lots of quality of life improvements, however it would be very difficult for me to add gifs for each one of them so I'll just mention them briefly here:

[list]
[*] Tweaked camera rotation
[*] The car turns transparent when overlapping with the aim
[*] Auto-aim
[*] Indicators and arrows for where enemies are coming from
[*] Indicators on top of enemies
[*] Better intersection taking
[*] Added biome specific music with proper transitions
[*] Added support for albedo textures
[*] Added 2D billboards in the game
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/82d825ae3813d06a84eeebaeff69fbe1f9f4fb69.jpg[/img]

[h2]Caves[/h2]

Caves? CAVES!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/49033073ab1bc5cd34044291c27a47646768dc64.png[/img]

No, they are not the plain old tunnels that I showed in the previous update but reskinned ⁽ᵗʰᵉʸ ᵃᶜᵗᵘᵃˡˡʸ ᵃʳᵉ⁾.

[h2]Different intersections[/h2]

During Dev.Play and DevKnights playtesting lots of people complained about the intersection paths being the same and having 0 impact on gameplay. Now I added the ability for me to customize how each path behaves when taken.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/05516cbb832b3c4f5812dfea5ffc97370ebd07d5.gif[/img]

[h2]City[/h2]

We started working on the city of the game. Firstly we want to have a full gameplay loop in this biome so we can hopefully push towards releasing a public demo, not just showcasing the build at romanian gamedev events. 

Secondly, this Steam page is reaaaaaaly outdated since February, and we should really push towards renewing it.

That being said, here's how the city in the game looks so far:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/221c97218d4f4f79756a5baf0ab254fb3bd694ac.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/1fe130ef86eb2d5314bab0f72d3cd1227cf24965.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/6b9abecf74fdf5c7f958dff385b6e8275e115da6.png[/img]

[h2]Split-screen multiplayer[/h2]

Yo, check this out: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/89d789d86a890f1f2d7fe607fe62de7f70ddfed5.gif[/img]

This feature is added mostly because I want to make a multiplayer game for the first time. Now, since making it multiplayer over the internet is pretty hard, I'm beginning with baby steps, aka making it split-screen multiplayer.

[h2]Next up[/h2]

We'll continue making the game look good and adding features as we went to update the Steam page (which is old as...), and maybe push towards releasing a public demo at the beginning of 2025. 

[h1]New team members[/h1]

Ok, so this is kinda major news. A while back I introduced Asterix on [url=https://discord.gg/NgZ3ygb8N5]our Discord server[/url] as the 3D artist for the game. Well, life happened and Asterix can't really focus on creating content for an indie game right now. However, he is still part of the team, helping us with ideas, advice, and anything of value he can provide.

So who's gonna make the models for this game then? Well, let me introduce you Andreea and Daria (EMotii and Daria respectively on [url=https://discord.gg/NgZ3ygb8N5]our Discord server[/url])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/b209a19749d0925f37f1d500c41f595db1c229fa.png[/img]

They already started working on stuff: the blocks and the spaceship car that you see in the gifs above are all made by them. In my opinion their work is amazing and I can already see the game taking shape into what it's supposed to be.

[h1]Social media[/h1]

So far, I've been posting game progress on my personal accounts (SilviuShader), but now that we are a team of 5, we decided to create official pages for the studio.

You can follow us on:

Twitter: [url=https://x.com/pixelbois_games]@pixelbois_games[/url]
Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/pixelbois_games/]@pixelbois_games[/url]

You can also join [url=https://discord.gg/NgZ3ygb8N5]our Discord server[/url])!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/42ee28d5f383e9d849764fefa716f2cd18d6f67f.png[/img]

Lately it wasn't so active for multiple reasons. One of them being the lack of progress updates during june and july. That's because I waited until the official introduction of Andreea and Daria before posting anything new, so people know where the new 3D models come from.

About a month ago I asked on a Discord poll if we should organize weekly meets between us (the team members of Pixelbois) and you (the fanbase). The common answer was "yes", so we'll try to do that.

Expect a message from me on the Discord server regarding this. I think we (at least some of us) can manage to join the #talk channel weekly with you guys, so stay tuned for that.

[h1]Till next time[/h1]

That's it for this update. Again, I wanted to make these updates monthly, hopefully it's gonna work starting with september? Time will tell. Thank you for taking the time to follow the progress of the game and of Pixelbois!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/c1a95e79cbf26fe211368a70dea08395a4ef56c7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: THE BIG BAD CUBE BOSS - Movement tweaks, Intersections - DEV.PLAY
notes.content:
SilviuShader here! To be honest I completely forgor 💀 about the existence of these posts, so here you go, a massive post summarizing what I've been posting on Discord and Twitter lately.

Since the Steam page of this game was created, many things happened.

[h1]Better Movement[/h1]

First of all, most of the movement code was rewritten. I wasn't really happy with how movement felt when the page was created, something fell off. I had to rewrite a good part of it so it feels more natural. Back then, the movement was relative to the center of the road. Right now, the camera movement is relative to the center of the road, but the movement of the player is relative to the camera (2 layers of indirection). This makes it feel way more natural.

[h1]Intersections[/h1]

Intersections are something I planned to add for a long time. The game wasn't built with intersections in mind, unlike PalmRide, so I had to do a lot of work to make the game support them. They also caused lots of bugs in the world generation, which hopefully are now fixed (but only time will tell).

Now, you'll see the intersections in game, however, here's how they look behind the scenes (and what I have to work with as a dev):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/f1ed7db3b30367d258babf884e11ecdb6fca6b3b.gif[/img]

[h1]Enemies and bosses[/h1]

The code for enemies was rewritten, now they appear more naturally in the game and overall feel better. The previous enemies used the same code as the player for movement, which was quite hard to work with so they moved naturally. I changed the approach, and instead gave them their own unique movement code.

Now, there is a long way to go until they are actually useful to the gameplay (multiple types of enemies, with different patterns), but so far, the foundation for them seems to be solid enough.

I also started adding bosses. For now, there is only a big fat cube as a "boss". It doesn't do anything besides spinning endlessly. but that's good enough for now as I only focused on implementing the bosses system. Actual bosses with different attack patterns will soon come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/d9596ef9698498659139620220955335ea162ad3.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/9d1a118832c4a5eb1677b2d99cccbfa59782dfad.png[/img]

[h1]Duotone[/h1]

I experimented with a new effect I found on Twitter by one of Unity's employees. The effect is called Duotone and it can be found [url=https://github.com/keijiro/Duotone]here[/url].

These are the results I managed to obtain using the technique:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/8a404dd2691e0cb45eb6bf04a3100cd9055106b1.png[/img]

There were a few problems though. Firstly, the code I wrote for this effect was a huge mess. Secondly, it didn't look that good in the game after all, and I struggled making illumination look and feel good. The outlines were also hard to make look good.

And thus, I temporarily gave up on the effect. It probably won't make it into the game, but I may still tweak the rendering of the game to look more similar (in this case, it may lose some of the Star Fox vibe, however the dithered contrast I would implement may help enhance the retro synthwave atmosphere, going a bit into future funk territory) 

[h1]Shadows and highlights[/h1]

I also added shadows and highlights below objects. I think they look pretty neat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/5a87d18a7b096895941eee81ce5f2070d614e762.jpg[/img]

[h1]UI[/h1]

The UI elements of PalmRide are soooooooo back, baby! Now with fancy 3D graphics in the UI (Temple OS style)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/7027d456023ba63ead1564c1eae620cb60d63a25.png[/img]

[h1]TLDR[/h1]

Anyway, here's a video that showcases the current state of the game, and all things I mentioned above:

[previewyoutube=W5C0CWBauzA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Dev.Play[/h1]

For those who don't know what Dev.Play is, well... let me tell you. It's a conference where game developers meet, attend talks, showcase their games and so on. Anyway, I am also attending Dev.Play this year, and there will be a booth where I'll showcase this game. 

There will also be a Steam sale, and PalmRide will be on that sale during the event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/0356288618c12b88390055e6ce331745118fbf09.png[/img]

More info about the event can be found [url=https://dev-play.ro/]here[/url].

So, if you are in Bucharest and want to see me or the game, we can meet at Dev.Play. Otherwise, you can still join our [url= https://discord.gg/NgZ3ygb8N5]Discord server[/url], and talk there. I show sings of life on Discord more than I do here....

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

Well, we're preparing the game for Dev.Play, the goals would be to make the city more alive (props, music, and so on). We'll see how much we can accomplish in the time we have remaining until then. 

The Steam page should also be updated soon to reflect the state of the game as it is right now, so that may happen soon.

Here are some things that we'll be working on this month (and hopefully finish.. at least some of them?)
[list]
[*] 3D Models for the city
[*] Song for the city zone

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861102/4795652fd3452754a51f6fd427c95cc515581f18.png[/img]

[*] Shadows (they are implemented, but the code needs a little bit of cleanup)
[*] Tweak the movement some more
[*] Fix shooting/ fighting bosses bugs (they are very minor, but still there)
[*] Greater movement range for the player (so it actually collides with the environment)
[*] Split-screen rendering
[*] Ability to compile it for Linux
[*] Story
[/list]

[h1]Release[/h1]

I was hoping the game will be released during the fall of 2024, but the things move slower than I was expecting, so I think the game will be ready about... a year from now... but we'll see. 

For all of us (me, Asterix, COVALENT) life happened so that we can't really focus our efforts on this game full time, so we are kinda grinding in our remaining time (when we still got energy). But still, I like where the game is going, and progress seems to be going good, even though it's a bit slow.

I am once again, asking you to join our [url= https://discord.gg/NgZ3ygb8N5]Discord server[/url], because I usually forget about the community of the Steam page. But I check the Discord messages very frequently.

That's all for now!
